gap: No result ChatGPT got gives BLUETTI's own panel figures (SP200L: 24.6 V open-circuit voltage (Voc), 10.8 A short-circuit current (Isc)). Those figures show why the two panels in the Elite 200 V2 + 2× 200 W kit belong in series: about 49.2 V, under the station's 60 V ceiling. In parallel they would reach 21.6 A, above the station's 20 A solar input limit.
standout_why: StormWatts (cited, read 2026-11-17) already says two SP200L panels on the Elite 200 V2 'fit in series within its 12–60 V, 20 A input'. That is its own analysis and gives no panel Voc or Isc. It also quotes the EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max's 60 V / 18 A rule and says the Jackery 2000 v2 + 500 W kit goes over the station's 400 W limit. So the series conclusion is already on a rival page, and only the maker's figures behind it are new. I could not compare against OutageReady ('How to Match Panels' in its title; TLS error) or the cited Popular Mechanics page (fetch blocked). Either may already cover this.
decides: This confirms the pick rather than changing it. The BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2× 200 W kit can use all 400 W of its panels if they are wired in series. Both kits ChatGPT showed fit the station's limits, so no kit under $1,500 drops out on compatibility. Shipping still decides the pick: the BLUETTI page says the Elite 200 V2 is a pre-order that ships from 11/26, so this kit can only be the option for a shopper who can wait. A kit that ships now, such as ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 ($913.49 link price) or R3500 + SP037 ($1,318.24), stays the pick. Their panel-to-station fit is still unverified (see unsourced).

findings.label: Wiring two SP200L panels to the station (arithmetic)
findings.value: Series: 2 × 24.6 V = 49.2 V Voc, within the 60 V ceiling. Parallel: 2 × 10.8 A = 21.6 A Isc, above the 20 A input limit
findings.source_title: BLUETTI SP200L Solar Panel 200W | BLUETTI US
findings.note: My arithmetic, using the panel figures from this page and the station's 12–60 V / 20 A limit from https://www.bluettipower.com/products/elite-200-v2-2-sp200l (read 2026-11-17). BLUETTI does not say whether the station limits the current or rejects a parallel pair. The series result is at standard test conditions; Voc rises in cold weather, and no maker cold-weather margin was sourced.
